participant_id.Description: Unique participant identifier (as in the source release and in Table 1 of Verwoert et al. 2022)

age.Description: Age of the participant at time of testing (source participants.tsv). Cohort (Verwoert et al. 2022, Methods 'Participants'): mean age 32 years (range 16-50).

sex.Description: Biological sex of the participant (source participants.tsv). Cohort (Verwoert et al. 2022, Methods 'Participants'): 5 male, 5 female.

handedness.Description: Handedness (source column 'hand'; n/a for every participant in the source). Not reported in the data descriptor (Verwoert et al. 2022) or the OSF record nrgx6.

n_contacts_implanted.Description: Number of implanted sEEG contacts (Verwoert et al. 2022, Table 1 'Implanted'; equals the number of rows of the participant's *_electrodes.tsv). Total 1317.

n_contacts_recorded.Description: Number of recorded contacts, excluding the reference contact, which is inherently carried in all recorded contacts (Verwoert et al. 2022, Table 1 'Recorded'). Total 1103.

native_language.Description: Native language. All participants were native speakers of Dutch (Verwoert et al. 2022, Methods 'Participants')

pathology.Description: Clinical indication for the sEEG implantation: pharmaco-resistant epilepsy; electrode locations were determined purely by clinical necessity (Verwoert et al. 2022, Methods 'Participants'). Seizure onset zone, aetiology and epilepsy duration are not reported.

implanted_hemisphere.Description: Hemisphere(s) with implanted shafts, derived from this release: shaft label prefix of the contacts in *_space-ACPC_electrodes.tsv (L... / R...), checked against the sign of the mean ACPC x coordinate of each shaft (all shafts consistent). Not tabulated in the paper.

n_shafts.Description: Number of sEEG electrode shafts (distinct shaft labels in *_space-ACPC_electrodes.tsv; each shaft holds 5-18 contacts per the paper)

n_shafts_left.Description: Number of shafts labelled L... (left hemisphere), from *_electrodes.tsv

n_shafts_right.Description: Number of shafts labelled R... (right hemisphere), from *_electrodes.tsv
